newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to sell unused uranium from nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Manila to sell unused uranium from nuclear plant.

text.p: State-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) will sell $20 to $30 million worth of uranium through a public tender by year-end, Napocor chairman Francisco Viray said on Thursday.
Bid documents for the sale are being finalized, Viray told reporters.

The uranium was supposed to fuel the 620-megawatt Bataan Nuclear Power Plant which was later mothballed as it became the subject of a legal battle between the Philippine government and its builders, Westinghouse Electric Corp and Burns & Roe.

Napocor officials said the power firm has to secure the approval of the United States Export-Import Bank, a major creditor for the BNPP construction. The loan agreement with the bank had stipulated that the power firm can only purchase but not sell nuclear fuel.
Napocor is planning to convert the nuclear facility into a gas-fired power plant.
